doc.description:
Engagement secrets live only for the lifetime of a session:

- ``aes_key`` — beacon channel AES-256 key (``sessions/key.aes``).
- ``rat_key`` — beacon HMAC signing key (``payload.json``).
- ``session_magic`` — activation string baked into lab implants.

``rotate_session_secrets`` generates all three with ``secrets``/``os.urandom``,
persists them and mirrors the values onto the live config object so the C2,
the shell and the implant builders read the same secrets in one deployment.
``clean`` rotates them again after artifact removal, and the C2 rotates on
boot when ``rotate_keys_on_boot`` is enabled, so nothing durable ships with
a secret that is public knowledge.

name: rotate_session_secrets
signature: def rotate_session_secrets(config_obj: Any = None, sessions_dir: str | os.PathLike[str] = _SESSIONS_DIRNAME) -> dict[str, str]

doc.summary: Generate and persist a fresh set of session secrets.

params.name: config_obj
params.description: Optional live config wrapper (``core.config.Config``) whose attributes are refreshed in memory.

params.name: sessions_dir
params.description: Directory that holds the on-disk AES key file.

returns.description:
Mapping with the generated ``aes_hex``, ``rat_key`` and
``session_magic`` values as strings.

raises.name: OSError
raises.description: if the AES key file or ``payload.json`` cannot be written.

name: ensure_session_secrets
signature: def ensure_session_secrets(config_obj: Any = None, rotate: bool = False, sessions_dir: str | os.PathLike[str] = _SESSIONS_DIRNAME) -> dict[str, str]

doc.summary: Return valid session secrets, rotating them when required.

params.name: config_obj
params.description: Optional live config wrapper refreshed in memory.

params.name: rotate
params.description: Force a full rotation regardless of current validity.

params.name: sessions_dir
params.description: Directory that holds the on-disk AES key file.
